lines.en: : Sensei?...Why are we at McDonald’s?...
: That’s a question for Ayane, not me. I wanted to leave you at the party and try to un-fuck this timeline.
: Because I’m unworthy of your attention and make everything worse by merely being involved?
: No. Because this timeline is extremely fucked up and no one even remembers that Christmas exists all of a sudden.
: You shouldn’t say bad words. Your tongue could catch on fire and then everything would taste like pain for the rest of your life.
: Does “pain” have a flavor now?
: Like fermented maggots left out to cook in the sun on a hot summer day- their wriggling slowly being cut down by celestial rays of fire that pour from the mouth of a star like-
: Okay, yeah. That sounds pretty terrible. So I’ll try to be a little less abrasive from now on if that’s what will make you happy.
: Thank you. And I’m sorry again for making you waste your time on me. You should be safe from divine intervention now that I’ve had my medicine.
: I think most of us are more concerned about your safety when you do things like that than our own. We know you’re not going to hurt us.
: But why would anyone be concerned about my safety?
: I’m safe within the arms of God. And no one likes me to begin with. They think I’m scary.
: No one thinks you’re scary, Yasu.
: But I can hear their thoughts sometimes and all of those thoughts are about how scary I am. Or about how desperately they long for the light that you produce.
: Though, their words concerning that last part are typically a lot more vulgar and make me want to shut my brain off.
: We all want to shut our brain off sometimes. Not everyone welcomes those voices you hear. But I guess not everyone gets them to begin with. And suddenly I am envious.
: Even fewer have visions. So what I tirelessly struggle to understand is how you seem to fit in more than I do despite being even more “special.”
: Well, for one, I can’t predict the future. So I think people might get a little uncomfortable around you since you can. They don’t want to know what comes next.
: Is that really what I’m doing, though?...
: Are the things I hear and messages I receive really premonitions? Or just echoes of the past that circled the divine globe and found their way to me far too late?
: Given that the past doesn’t make a sound, I’m going to go with the former. But I guess you can never really know in a place like this.
: I don’t like it...
: Without the voices to tell me where I am, I often forget. And when I forget, I’m scared too.
: So maybe I’m more like a moth than I am a roach or worm — constantly heading toward the light because it’s the only thing I know. The only thing that keeps me warm.
: Well, whatever you are, it doesn’t really matter to me. Medication or not, I don’t intend to leave you behind. Even when you get annoying and scary.
: Both you and Touka are far too kind to me. I’ve done nothing to deserve this.
: Not everything needs to be deserved. Hasn’t your God taught you to treat others the way you wish to be treated? I thought that was a common denominator in, like...every religion.
: I was taught to think not of what I stand to gain, but what I can obtain for Him. Chasing after things that only benefit me does nothing for the greater good.
: So we’re all just tools for you to strengthen your connection to God then?
: You are bugs, the same way I am. Small, ugly, pathetic creatures who will surely fade away without the help of something more powerful. I just want to save you.
: But...
: I also think I like bugs.
: They’re interesting. Easier to understand. So easy that, sometimes, I can do it without even trying.
: They don’t sin. They don’t understand malice or scorn. They’re just so...simple. And act on instinct. But this normally means that they run away before I even get the chance to say hi.
: So, yes. To answer your question, you are tools that I must use to carve a path for He Who Lost His Sight. But you are more than that too.
: Well, that just means you are as well then.
: Sometimes, I think so.
: Others, I feel more like a cocoon.
Suddenly, my phone begins to vibrate. What perfect timing too — as Yasu now seems locked in one more bout of spiritual contemplation.
: One second, Yasu. I need to answer this.
: I wonder if that will ever happen to me.
: Wonder if...what? If you’ll get a text message?
: Mm. I’m not supposed to concern myself with material things though.
: Concern yourself with whatever makes you happy. Living for someone else sucks.
: Okay! Sorry. I’m back.
: The ice cream machine was broken and Geoffrey wasn’t available to come fix it on such short notice. So I just ran to the convenience store and got these instead.
: I’m just thankful it’s Halloween since I’m supposed to be banned from that one and I don’t think they recognized me.
: Halloween?...
: Oh, right. Sorry. Christmalloween. The...totally real holiday that has always existed and isn’t just a symptom of some weird butterfly effect thing.
: Good cover. That sounded really natural, Ayane. Why are there only two ice cream cones?
: So I can make you lick mine.
: I am suddenly not hungry anymore.
: So! What’d you guys talk about while I was gone? Does Yasu’s transcendent memory bank hold any of the secrets that we’re looking for?
: Do we even know what secrets we’re looking for yet? Or just that Maya and Ami have something to do with it?
: Something to do with what? I’m confused.
: Oh, and thank you for the ice cream. I will pay you back once Touka allows me to carry my own money.
: No need! I’m rich too and spending money helps me spite my dad. So if there’s anything else you want, feel free to tell me about that too!
: She’s not allowed to long for material goods or her god will turn her into a sun-cooked maggot or something like that.
: Close enough. But I must regretfully inform you that my memory is not “transcendent” as you’ve said. I merely relay information from the texts of His eternal diary.
: Then, do you happen to know anything about the world repeating itself?
: I must regretfully inform you that my memory is not “transcendent” as you’ve said. I merely relay information from the texts of His eternal diary.
: Welp, guess that answers that question.
: I’m sorry I cannot be of more assistance. All I know is what I am permitted to know. Everything else is waste.
: Maybe we just need to ask in a...more roundabout way? Like — hey, Yasu. Does “His eternal diary” happen to have any notes on Maya being the origin of the world?
: Merely theorizing about the formation of the world is heresy when we already know it was Nozomu who created everything.
: Akira? Are you o-
: Yeah...I’m fine. Just a...flash-headache, I guess. Nothing to be concerned about.
: What would lead you to believe that Maya has something to do with the creation of this world? Is she not a normal teenage girl?
: Well...Ayane and I just sort of...felt like she was relevant for no good reason today. That’s all.
: What about Ami then? Does your weird brain diary mention anything about-
: I think we can rule her out for the time being, actually.
: Really? So she didn’t have anything to say when you confronted her earlier?
: Nope. Just more...Ami stuff. You know. Incest. Things like that.
: Aah! Maggot tongue!
: Maggot tongue?
: Right. That’s where the sun-cooked maggot thing comes from.
: Regardless, I’m glad she’s not involved. That definitely makes me feel a little better, at least.
: Because if she’d known about any of this and was just pretending not to for my sake, I don’t really know how I’d handle it.
: Anyway, Yasu! There’s gotta be some sort of apocalyptic premonition in whatever your religious texts are, right?
: Oh, yes. Many. The end of days is upon us.
: It sure is. And the key to salvation is what again?
: Transference. The recycling of light from man to woman to God.
: In Japanese, please?
: He needs to splooge inside of us.
: Oh, yay. Then I guess we’re already saved.
: Surely it’s more complicated than just that, though. Right, Yasu?
: Correct. Upon receiving light from one who was chosen, females must deliver that light to God through a spiritual linking ritual in which the light is extracted from us.
: Ew...So does he just go in there with a vacuum or something?
: I am not sure, for this body is just as pure as the moment it was born. But from what I understand, it is a feeling that transcends even the act of receiving the light in the first place.
: Well, that doesn’t sound so bad. So how do we do this ritual thing then? I’ve received plenty of light. Your God would be happy to have me.
: You’re actually...interested?
: You’re actually interested?
: It couldn’t hurt to try, right? Like, we’ve gotten the hard part out of the way a zillion times already. The worst thing that can happen is just...nothing.
: Ayane, are you forgetting that gods actually exist in this world? We can’t keep denying them when we’ve seen them ourselves.
: So then...she has seen the visage as well? But I don’t...no. No, that can’t be true. I’d have heard something.
: I’ve seen a visage. Or...visages. But maybe it’s not the one you’re thinking of?
: But there is only one. There can only be one. What else have you seen?
: Yasu, they’re visions. We can’t explain them. They come out of nowhere, leave, and more than half the time, we can’t even remember what we saw.
: That’s something your god would be able to find out if he vacuumed the light out of me though, right? Then he could...tell you about it? Is that how it works?
: We...that...
: I’m not sure, but...
: We must try...
: The two of you must come to the cathedral right away. We must begin as soon as possible.
: Now, hold on. I’m not exactly comfortable with this. You’ve already locked me in a jail cell once before and I’m not about to put Ayane through something like that.
: Sorry, she’s done what now?
: That was a mistake! I won’t lock anyone anywhere anymore!
: If Ayane is volunteering to be a vessel, it is my duty to ensure that she becomes one! The two of you must connect under the supervision of the council!
: Council? What council?
: I think she wants us to have sex in front of a bunch of stuffed rabbits.
: Not alone! I’ll be there too!
: What, like...watching?
: Unless...He instructs me to...assist.
: I am suddenly much less inclined to go through with this ritual.
: See? You can’t just agree to things like that. You don’t know what you’re getting yourself into.
: I can’t believe I almost just joined a cult in front of you. Today’s been a weird day.
: Well, I’m sure it’s weird for Yasu too. So why don’t we just...chill out for a few minutes and eat before we head back to the party? We have more sleuthing to do anyway.
: Mnghh...do we really need to sleuth tonight? I’m so tired. And any time we try to figure anything out at parties, it always ends up making everything worse.
: You can go home if you want. But I still need to meet up with Maya again later, and I don’t even know if Makoto has gotten ahold of Yumi yet.
: Without you? I don’t want to leave without you. You’re the reason I- wait. You’re meeting up with Maya later?
: Long story. You don’t want the details.
: Ooooh?
: Plus, at least one of us needs to go back or Yasu will get lost. I don’t want her blood on my hands.
: She’s found her way back from further places before! Isn’t that right, Yasu?
: I will always find my way to the light. That is what it means to be a moth.
: See? She’s fine. Let’s just take a break tonight and go hang out in the dorm. And, you know what? Screw it. Yasu can come too!
: You do not want me there. I will only get in the way.
: The two of you have already done so much for me tonight. And to think that you could show me such kindness after everything you’ve lost means far more than you understand.
: I hope to be that strong one day. I really do.
: Right now, I can barely walk without assistance. And I’m little more than a barrier of flesh between the two of you and the future you chase after.
: That’s the thing, Yasu. What we’re chasing after is the mere possibility of a future. And with the way things are now-
: I have to go.
: I think I’m going to be sick.
: Ayane? What-
: I HAVE TO GO!
: What happened?! Do you need an ambulance?! What’s going-
: I happened...
: It was me...
: What are you talking about? What did you-
: I don’t know! I never know!
: People are always getting hurt when they talk to me and I don’t understand why!
: It’s always been that way! So what am I supposed to do?! Never talk again?! Because I’ve  already tried being alone and that didn’t help!
: I don’t want to just watch everyone go away! But I can’t help anyone either because I can’t get close to them!
: There’s so much pain! It’s everywhere and I feel it all! So why can’t anyone feel mine?! Why?! Why, why, why?!
What is this?
Why do I feel like I’ve been here before?
Why do I feel like I’ve done this before?
Why do I feel like there’s something missing?
You feel compelled to hug her back. But as her tears soak through the fabric of your shirt, you feel like doing so would be a betrayal to someone else.
You get embarrassed because you feel like they might be watching. Yet, you don’t know who or where or when.
You don’t know anything.
So your arms just hang there while a confused girl wraps hers around your body, desperately wishing that you might somehow understand the anguish she feels in this moment.
But you don’t.
You are far too selfish, even when your heart belongs to someone else.
So you wish the pain away, but wind up failing.
All you ever do is fail.
That’s why you hurt in the first place.
You are worthless. Spent. You’ll never be good for anyone or anything. So why don’t you just give up now and go back to normal?
Why don’t you do what you’re good for instead of wasting your time wishing? Because wishes don’t come true. You know that. Don’t you? Give up. Quit.
Push her away. Tell her to fuck off. Tell her that she ruined your night. That Ayane hates her now too. Do something. Don’t just stand there.
This isn’t entertaining. You aren’t meant to do this. Give up. Give up.
Give up.
